name: Sylvan-Moulin
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
